title: News and current affairs
objectives: Read a Tagalog news article and extract who, what, when, where, why
Decode headline grammar: dropped markers, clipped verbs, and news abbreviations
Command core vocabulary of politics, the economy and disasters
Summarize a news report aloud in your own words

grammar.title: Headline grammar: what the editors delete
grammar.explanation:
Tagalog headlines compress ruthlessly, and knowing the compression rules lets you expand them back. First deletion: markers. 'PANGULO BINATIKOS DAHIL SA BAGONG BUWIS' expands to Binatikos ang Pangulo dahil sa bagong buwis — the ang is gone and the focused noun moves to the front. Second: the linker and function words drop: '5 PATAY SA SUNOG SA QC' = Limang tao ang namatay sa sunog sa Quezon City.

Verbs in headlines often appear in the completed form without any aspect ambiguity intended (BINAHA ANG MAYNILA), or as bare roots and nouns where English would use a verb: ARESTADO ANG SUSPEK 'suspect (is) arrested', TODO-SUPORTA ANG GOBYERNO 'government (gives) all-out support'.

Abbreviations are their own dialect: QC (Quezon City), PNP (Philippine National Police), DOH (Department of Health), LGU (local government unit), OFW (overseas Filipino worker), 'Pinas ('the Philippines). Numbers stay as digits. When you read a headline aloud in a summary, restore the deleted markers: a B2 speaker says Inaresto ng PNP ang suspek, not headline-speak.

grammar.title: The reporter's toolbox: ayon kay, umano, sinabi ni
grammar.explanation:
News prose is built on attribution, and you already know its core from reported speech. The workhorses: ayon kay/sa 'according to' (Ayon sa DOH, bumaba ang mga kaso); sinabi ni X na... 'X said that...'; iginiit 'insisted', idinagdag 'added', ipinaliwanag 'explained', inamin 'admitted', itinanggi 'denied' — all object-focus verbs whose subject is the statement itself.

The particle umano marks unverified claims, the print equivalent of daw/raw: Ang suspek ay umano'y kasapi ng sindikato — 'The suspect is allegedly a member of a syndicate.' Court-adjacent stories are wallpapered with umano and diumano to keep the outlet safe from libel. When you summarize news aloud, switch umano back to daw/raw: Kasapi raw siya ng sindikato.

Useful frames for your own summaries: Tungkol ang balita sa... 'The news is about...'; Ayon sa ulat, ... 'According to the report...'; Ang pangunahing punto ay... 'The main point is...'; Sa madaling salita, ... 'In short...'. Close with the significance: Mahalaga ito dahil... 'This matters because...'.

grammar.title: Numbers, rises and falls: the language of the economy
grammar.explanation:
Economic reporting runs on a small set of motion verbs. Up: tumaas 'rose', umakyat 'climbed', sumipa (colloquial) 'kicked up', pumalo sa 'hit (a level)'. Down: bumaba 'fell', bumagsak 'crashed, collapsed', humupa 'subsided (of inflation, floods, emotions alike)'. Steady: nanatili 'remained', walang pagbabago 'unchanged'.

Quantities attach with sa and ng: Tumaas ang presyo ng bigas ng limang piso 'rice rose by five pesos'; Pumalo sa 6.1 porsyento ang implasyon 'inflation hit 6.1 percent'. Percentages read as porsyento; fractions of change use bahagdan in very formal prose.

Disaster reporting has its own core set you should recognize instantly: sugatan 'injured (person)', nasawi 'perished' (the news euphemism for died), nawawala 'missing', lumikas 'evacuated', idineklara ang state of calamity, nasalanta 'devastated', pinsala 'damage' (Unit 5), and the storm signals: Signal No. 3, binagyo, binaha, lumindol 'an earthquake struck'. Note nasawi and nasalanta — na- verbs of misfortune, cousins of the abilitative na- you already know.

example.tl: Nanguna sa mga balita kagabi ang pagtaas ng presyo ng langis.
example.en: The rise in oil prices led the news last night.

example.tl: Basahin muna natin ang mga ulo ng balita ngayong umaga.
example.en: Let's first read this morning's headlines.

example.tl: Tinanong ng mga mamamahayag ang kalihim tungkol sa badyet.
example.en: The journalists asked the secretary about the budget.

example.tl: Lumabas ang istorya sa unang pahina ng pahayagan.
example.en: The story appeared on the newspaper's front page.

example.tl: Ayon sa pulisya, tatlo ang inaresto sa operasyon.
example.en: According to the police, three were arrested in the operation.

vocab.note: print equivalent of daw/raw; also diumano

example.tl: Ang opisyal ay tumanggap umano ng suhol.
example.en: The official allegedly accepted a bribe.

example.tl: Iginiit ng abogado na inosente ang kanyang kliyente.
example.en: The lawyer insisted that his client is innocent.

example.tl: Itinanggi ng kompanya ang anumang kinalaman sa pagtatapon ng kemikal.
example.en: The company denied any involvement in the chemical dumping.

example.tl: Inamin ng alkalde na kulang ang paghahanda ng lungsod.
example.en: The mayor admitted the city's preparation was lacking.

example.tl: Tumutol ang mga negosyante sa panukalang bagong buwis.
example.en: Business owners opposed the proposed new tax.

example.tl: Milyon-milyon ang inaasahang boboto sa darating na halalan.
example.en: Millions are expected to vote in the coming election.

example.tl: Naglahad ng plataporma ang bawat kandidato sa debate.
example.en: Each candidate laid out a platform at the debate.

example.tl: Naglaan ang pamahalaan ng pondo para sa mga nasalanta.
example.en: The government allocated funds for the disaster victims.

example.tl: Nagbitiw sa puwesto ang kalihim ng edukasyon.
example.en: The education secretary resigned from the post.

example.tl: Nilagdaan ng pangulo ang bagong batas kahapon.
example.en: The president signed the new law yesterday.

example.tl: Ibinasura ng korte ang kaso dahil kulang sa ebidensya.
example.en: The court dismissed the case for lack of evidence.

example.tl: Pumalo sa anim na porsyento ang implasyon noong Hulyo.
example.en: Inflation hit six percent in July.

example.tl: Sumirit ang presyo ng sibuyas bago mag-Pasko.
example.en: Onion prices shot up before Christmas.

example.tl: Tumaas ng limang piso ang pamasahe sa dyip.
example.en: Jeepney fares went up by five pesos.

example.tl: Bumagsak ang benta ng mga maliliit na tindahan.
example.en: Sales of small stores collapsed.

example.tl: Humupa na ang baha sa mga pangunahing kalsada.
example.en: The floods on the main roads have subsided.

vocab.note: usually completed: nasawi; noun use: mga nasawi 'the dead'

example.tl: Dalawa ang nasawi sa banggaan ng bus at trak.
example.en: Two perished in the bus-truck collision.

example.tl: Dinala ang mga sugatan sa pinakamalapit na ospital.
example.en: The injured were taken to the nearest hospital.

example.tl: Nasalanta ng bagyo ang mga sakahan sa hilagang Luzon.
example.en: The storm devastated the farms in northern Luzon.

example.tl: Lumindol nang magnitude 6.2 sa Mindanao kaninang madaling-araw.
example.en: A magnitude 6.2 earthquake struck Mindanao early this morning.

example.tl: Tuloy ang operasyong sagip sa gumuhong gusali.
example.en: The rescue operation at the collapsed building continues.

example.tl: Tumanggi siyang tumanggap ng suhol mula sa kontratista.
example.en: He refused to accept a bribe from the contractor.

example.tl: Iniimbestigahan ang umano'y katiwalian sa proyekto ng kalsada.
example.en: The alleged corruption in the road project is being investigated.

vocab.note: nagbitiw, nagbibitiw, magbibitiw; magbitiw sa puwesto

example.tl: Nagbitiw ang direktor matapos lumabas ang iskandalo.
example.en: The director resigned after the scandal came out.

example.tl: Sa madaling salita, hindi handa ang lungsod sa lindol.
example.en: In short, the city is not prepared for an earthquake.

dialogue.title: Pagsusuri ng balita sa almusal
dialogue.context: Husband and wife Rene and Marites read the morning news on their phones and practice summarizing for their daughter's school assignment.

lines.speaker: Rene
lines.tl: O, eto ang ulo ng balita: 'PAMASAHE SA DYIP TAAS-PRESYO SA LUNES'. Isalin daw ni Nina sa buong pangungusap para sa takdang-aralin niya.
lines.en: Here's the headline: 'JEEP FARE PRICE-HIKE ON MONDAY'. Nina's supposed to turn it into a full sentence for her homework.

lines.speaker: Marites
lines.tl: Madali 'yan: 'Tataas ang pamasahe sa dyip sa Lunes.' Ibinalik mo lang ang ang at ang tamang aspekto ng pandiwa.
lines.en: That's easy: 'Jeepney fares will rise on Monday.' You just restore the ang and the verb's proper aspect.

lines.speaker: Rene
lines.tl: Magaling. Ito pa: 'LIMANG BARANGAY BINAHA, DAAN-DAANG PAMILYA LUMIKAS'.
lines.en: Nice. Here's another: 'FIVE BARANGAYS FLOODED, HUNDREDS OF FAMILIES EVACUATED'.

lines.speaker: Marites
lines.tl: Binaha ang limang barangay, kaya lumikas ang daan-daang pamilya. May detalye ba kung saan?
lines.en: Five barangays were flooded, so hundreds of families evacuated. Any detail on where?

lines.speaker: Rene
lines.tl: Ayon sa ulat, sa may ilog daw, at humuhupa na umano ang tubig ngayong umaga.
lines.en: According to the report, near the river, and the water is allegedly subsiding this morning.

lines.speaker: Marites
lines.tl: Buti naman. O, ano naman itong sa ekonomiya? 'IMPLASYON PUMALO SA 6.1%'.
lines.en: Good. And what about this economy one? 'INFLATION HITS 6.1%'.

lines.speaker: Rene
lines.tl: Ibig sabihin, mas mabilis tumaas ang mga presyo kaysa noong nakaraang buwan. Kaya pala sumirit ang bigas at sibuyas.
lines.en: It means prices rose faster than last month. No wonder rice and onions shot up.

lines.speaker: Marites
lines.tl: May balita rin dito tungkol sa katiwalian — itinanggi raw ng kalihim na tumanggap siya ng suhol sa proyekto ng tulay.
lines.en: There's also news about corruption — the secretary reportedly denied accepting a bribe on the bridge project.

lines.speaker: Rene
lines.tl: 'Umano' ang gamit ng diyaryo, siyempre. Wala pang napapatunayan; kaso pa lang ang inihain.
lines.en: The paper uses 'allegedly', of course. Nothing's proven yet; only a case has been filed.

lines.speaker: Marites
lines.tl: Tamang-tama. Sa madaling salita: dapat matutong magbasa si Nina nang may pag-iingat — hindi lahat ng nasa ulo ng balita ay buong katotohanan.
lines.en: Exactly. In short: Nina should learn to read carefully — not everything in a headline is the whole truth.

lines.speaker: Rene
lines.tl: Itaga mo sa bato, mahuhusay na mambabasa ng balita ang anak natin.
lines.en: Mark my words, our daughter will be a sharp news reader.

reading.title: Balita: Pagbaha sa Lungsod ng San Mateo
reading.tl:
SAN MATEO — Umabot sa mahigit tatlong libong pamilya ang lumikas sa mga evacuation center matapos bahain ang labindalawang barangay sa lungsod na ito, dulot ng walang tigil na pag-ulan na dala ng Bagyong Ompong nitong Sabado ng gabi.

Ayon kay City Disaster Officer Ramon Bautista, pumalo sa halos dalawang metro ang taas ng tubig sa mga barangay na malapit sa ilog. "Nagsimula kaming maglikas ng mga residente bandang alas-otso ng gabi, bago pa umapaw ang ilog," ani Bautista. Dahil umano sa maagang paglikas, walang naitalang nasawi; dalawa lamang ang sugatan matapos madulas habang tumatawid sa baha.

Samantala, iginiit ng ilang residente na hindi lamang ulan ang dapat sisihin. "Taun-taon na lang kaming binabaha mula nang tambakan ang lupang taniman sa itaas ng subdivision," ayon kay Aling Corazon Reyes, limampu't walong taong gulang, na ikatlong beses nang lumikas ngayong taon. Itinanggi naman ng developer ng subdivision ang anumang kinalaman sa pagbaha at sinabing sumunod sila sa lahat ng permit.

Inamin ni Mayor Teresa Lim na kailangang repasuhin ang drainage system ng lungsod. "Naglaan na kami ng dalawampung milyong piso para sa pagpapalawak ng mga daluyan ng tubig," pahayag niya. Bunga ng pagbahang ito, idineklara ang lungsod sa ilalim ng state of calamity, na magpapabilis sa paglabas ng pondo para sa mga nasalanta.

Humupa na ang tubig sa karamihan ng mga lugar kahapon ng hapon, ngunit nananatili sa mga evacuation center ang halos limandaang pamilya.
reading.en:
SAN MATEO — More than three thousand families evacuated to evacuation centers after twelve barangays in this city were flooded, due to the nonstop rain brought by Typhoon Ompong on Saturday night.

According to City Disaster Officer Ramon Bautista, water levels hit almost two meters in the barangays near the river. "We began evacuating residents around eight in the evening, before the river overflowed," Bautista said. Allegedly because of the early evacuation, no deaths were recorded; only two were injured after slipping while crossing the floodwater.

Meanwhile, some residents insisted that the rain is not the only thing to blame. "We've been flooded every single year since the farmland above the subdivision was filled in," according to Aling Corazon Reyes, fifty-eight years old, who has evacuated for the third time this year. The subdivision's developer, for its part, denied any involvement in the flooding and said they complied with all permits.

Mayor Teresa Lim admitted that the city's drainage system needs to be reviewed. "We have allocated twenty million pesos for the widening of the waterways," she stated. As a result of this flood, the city was declared under a state of calamity, which will speed up the release of funds for the victims.

The water subsided in most areas yesterday afternoon, but almost five hundred families remain in the evacuation centers.

gloss.en: to fill in with earth, dump on

exercises.prompt: Expand the headline: 'KALIHIM NAGBITIW DAHIL SA ISKANDALO'.
choices: Nagbitiw ang kalihim dahil sa iskandalo.
Ang kalihim ay walang iskandalo.
Magbibitiw daw ang iskandalo ng kalihim.
Nagbitiw dahil ang kalihim sa iskandalo.
exercises.explain: Headlines drop ang and front the focused noun; expansion restores normal order: Nagbitiw ang kalihim dahil sa iskandalo — 'The secretary resigned because of the scandal.'

exercises.prompt: In a court story you read: 'Tumanggap umano ng suhol ang opisyal.' What does umano signal?
choices: The bribe was proven in court.
The claim is alleged, not verified by the outlet.
The official has already been convicted.
The reporter personally saw the bribe.
exercises.explain: Umano (also diumano) is the print equivalent of daw/raw: it marks the bribe-taking as an unverified allegation, protecting the outlet from libel.

exercises.prompt: ___ sa DOH, bumaba na ang mga kaso ng trangkaso ngayong buwan. (According to)
exercises.explain: Ayon sa + source is the news workhorse for attribution: 'According to the DOH, flu cases have gone down this month.'

exercises.prompt: Pumalo sa 6.8 porsyento ang implasyon. What happened?
choices: Inflation hit 6.8 percent.
Inflation fell by 6.8 percent.
Prices were frozen at 6.8 pesos.
The peso gained 6.8 percent.
exercises.explain: Pumalo sa + level = 'hit (a level)'. It reports the level reached, not a fall — falling would be bumaba or bumagsak.

exercises.prompt: Dalawa ang ___ at lima ang sugatan sa banggaan kaninang umaga. (perished — news euphemism)
exercises.hint: the na- verb of misfortune used instead of namatay
exercises.explain: Nasawi is the standard news euphemism for death in accidents and disasters, paired here with sugatan 'injured'.

exercises.tl: Ayon sa PAGASA, huhupa na ang ulan bukas ng umaga, pero mananatili ang mga alon na hanggang tatlong metro ang taas.
choices: Rain will subside tomorrow morning, but waves up to three meters will remain.
Rain will get stronger tomorrow, with three-meter floods.
The rain stopped three days ago, but returns tomorrow.
Waves subsided this morning after three hours of rain.
exercises.explain: Huhupa (contemplated of humupa) = 'will subside'; mananatili = 'will remain'; alon na hanggang tatlong metro = 'waves up to three meters'.

exercises.prompt: Itinanggi ng developer ang anumang kinalaman sa pagbaha, ngunit iginiit ng mga residente na nagsimula ang problema nang tambakan ang taniman.
exercises.answer: The developer denied any involvement in the flooding, but the residents insisted the problem began when the farmland was filled in.
accept: The developer denied any involvement in the flooding, but the residents insisted the problem began when the farmland was filled in
The developer denied any connection to the flooding, but residents insisted that the problem started when the farmland was filled in
The developer denied having anything to do with the flood, but the residents insisted the problem began when the farmland was covered with earth
exercises.explain: Itinanggi 'denied' and iginiit 'insisted' are the attribution verbs; anumang kinalaman = 'any involvement'; nang tambakan = 'when it was filled in'.

exercises.prompt: Based on the reading: why were there no deaths in the San Mateo flood?
choices: The flood was only ankle-deep.
Residents were evacuated early, before the river overflowed.
The city's new drainage system worked.
The typhoon changed course at the last minute.
exercises.explain: Bautista says evacuation began at 8 p.m., bago pa umapaw ang ilog — before the river overflowed — which is credited for the zero death toll.

exercises.prompt: According to the report, jeepney fares will rise by five pesos on Monday.
exercises.answer: Ayon sa ulat, tataas ng limang piso ang pamasahe sa dyip sa Lunes.
accept: Ayon sa ulat, tataas ng limang piso ang pamasahe sa dyip sa Lunes
Ayon sa ulat, tataas ang pamasahe sa dyip ng limang piso sa Lunes
Ayon sa ulat, sa Lunes tataas ng limang piso ang pamasahe sa dyip
exercises.explain: Ayon sa ulat frames the attribution; tumaas takes the amount of change as a ng-phrase (ng limang piso); pamasahe is the pang- derivation from Unit 2.

exercises.prompt: You're summarizing a news story aloud to a friend. The article says 'ang suspek ay umano'y kasapi ng sindikato'. What do you naturally say?
choices: Kasapi raw siya ng sindikato.
Kasapi umano po siya ng sindikato, ayon sa akin.
Ang suspek ay diumano'y kasapi.
Sindikato ang kasapi niya, totoo iyan.
exercises.explain: In speech, the print particle umano switches back to daw/raw: Kasapi raw siya ng sindikato. Keeping umano in chat sounds like reading the paper aloud; dropping the hedge entirely misreports an allegation as fact.

exercises.tl: Idineklara ang probinsya sa ilalim ng state of calamity matapos masalanta ng bagyo ang mga sakahan.
choices: The province was declared under a state of calamity after the storm devastated the farms.
The province canceled its calamity declaration despite the storm.
The farms were saved because of the calamity declaration.
A storm is expected to hit the province's farms next week.
exercises.explain: Idineklara... sa ilalim ng state of calamity = 'declared under a state of calamity'; matapos masalanta = 'after being devastated'. The declaration follows the damage.

exercises.prompt: In short, the city admitted that the drainage system needs to be reviewed to prevent flooding.
exercises.answer: Sa madaling salita, inamin ng lungsod na kailangang repasuhin ang drainage system upang maiwasan ang pagbaha.
accept: Sa madaling salita, inamin ng lungsod na kailangang repasuhin ang drainage system upang maiwasan ang pagbaha
Sa madaling salita, inamin ng lungsod na kailangan nang repasuhin ang drainage system para maiwasan ang pagbaha
Sa madaling salita, inamin ng lungsod na dapat repasuhin ang drainage system upang maiwasan ang baha
exercises.explain: Sa madaling salita opens the summary; inamin attributes the admission; upang maiwasan (Unit 5) states the preventive purpose.
